question: Estimate the photos uploaded to Google Photos daily from India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Photos auto-backed-up + manually uploaded? Yes — total uploads.
Includes screenshots and WhatsApp media auto-saved? Yes — anything that flows into Photos.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: Indian Google Photos users × photos taken per day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average new photos/screenshots per active user per day: ~12-15 (camera shots + screenshots + WhatsApp media).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily uploads from India: 450M × 13 = ~5.85 billion photos.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average new photos/screenshots per active user per day

calculationFlow: Active Google Photos users (auto-backup enabled): ~60% of Android = ~450M.
Average new photos/screenshots per active user per day: ~12-15 (camera shots + screenshots + WhatsApp media).
Daily uploads from India: 450M × 13 = ~5.85 billion photos.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Daily uploads from India: 450M × 13 = ~5.85 billion photos.
